info.description: REST interface for the Insights Platform Host Inventory application — V2 API.
info.title: Insights Host Inventory V2 REST Interface

externalDocs.description: How to use the Red Hat Insights API

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-rh-identity
ApiKeyAuth.description: Base64-encoded JSON identity header provided by 3Scale. Contains an org_id of the user issuing the request. Format: {"identity": {"org_id": "12345678"}}

pageParam.name: page
pageParam.description: A page number of the items to return.

perPageParam.name: per_page
perPageParam.description: A number of items to return per page.

sortParam.name: sort
sortParam.description: Comma-separated list of sort fields. Prefix a field with `-` for descending order. Examples: `?sort=-updated`, `?sort=display_name,-updated`, `?sort=-vulnerability.critical_cves,display_name`.

updatedStart.name: updated_start
updatedStart.description: Only show hosts updated after this timestamp.

updatedEnd.name: updated_end
updatedEnd.description: Only show hosts updated before this timestamp.

lastCheckInStart.name: last_check_in_start
lastCheckInStart.description: Only show hosts whose last check-in is after this timestamp.

lastCheckInEnd.name: last_check_in_end
lastCheckInEnd.description: Only show hosts whose last check-in is before this timestamp.

tagsParam.name: tags
tagsParam.description: Filter by host tags. Tags are in namespace/key=value format. Namespace and value are optional (e.g. "insights-client/os=rhel", "key=value", "key"). Each component is URL-encoded and limited to 255 characters.

registeredWithParam.name: registered_with
registeredWithParam.description: Filter by reporter that has ever reported the host before.

hostIdListParam.name: host_id_list
hostIdListParam.description: A comma-separated list of host UUIDs.

ErrorResponse.title: RFC 7807 Problem Details
ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response following RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs.

type.description: A URI reference that identifies the problem type. Defaults to "about:blank" when no specific problem type URI is defined.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

PaginationOut.title: Paginated Response Envelope
PaginationOut.description: Unified pagination envelope. All collection endpoints use this structure, including resource-types. The links field provides navigation URLs with full query string preservation.

total.description: Total number of items matching the query.

count.description: The number of items on the current page.

per_page.description: The number of items per page.

PaginationLinks.title: Pagination Navigation Links
PaginationLinks.description: Navigation links for paginated responses. Each link is a full URL path preserving all original query parameters; only the page parameter changes.

previous.description: URL for the previous page, or null on page 1.

next.description: URL for the next page, or null on the last page.

AccountNumber.description: A Red Hat Account number that owns the host.

OrgId.description: The Org ID of the tenant that owns the host.

HostId.description: A durable and reliable platform-wide host identifier.

InsightsId.description: A UUID assigned by the insights-client. This field is a canonical fact.

SubscriptionManagerId.description: A Red Hat Subscription Manager ID of a RHEL host. This field is a canonical fact.

SatelliteId.description: A Red Hat Satellite ID of a RHEL host. This field is a canonical fact.

BiosUuid.description: A UUID of the host machine BIOS. This field is a canonical fact.

IpAddresses.description: Host's network IP addresses. This field is a canonical fact.

Fqdn.description: A host's Fully Qualified Domain Name. This field is a canonical fact.

MacAddresses.description: Host's network interfaces MAC addresses. This field is a canonical fact.

ProviderId.description: Host's reference in the external source e.g. Alibaba, AWS EC2, Azure, GCP, IBM etc. This field is a canonical fact and requires provider_type.

ProviderType.description: Type of external source e.g. Alibaba, AWS EC2, Azure, GCP, IBM, etc. This field is a canonical fact and requires provider_id.

FactSet.title: Host facts under a namespace
FactSet.description: A set of string facts belonging to a single namespace.

namespace.description: A namespace the facts belong to.
